ownEvents_desc: Without a series — they don't count toward any series standings.
unassigned: This club is not assigned to any series for the current year.

members.title: Members
members.leaveConfirm: Leave this club? Your registrations in its squads stay until the club changes them.
members.addHint: By the email address of their account — they are in at once, no acceptance needed. Whoever has no account registers first.
members.crestHint: The club's crest — on the club's page, the standings and the results. Tap it to replace it.

mine.title: My club
mine.notSignedIn: Sign in to see your club.
mine.noClubText: You are not in any club yet.
mine.noTeamsText: This club is not registered for any series yet, so there is no squad to put together.
mine.roleMember: You are a member of this club
mine.eventsHint: Every matchday of a series this club is registered in, and every event it is entered in on its own. Open one to name the crew — from the squad, in advance.
mine.eventsEmpty: This club is not entered in any event yet.
mine.seriesHint: Every series this club is registered in. Open one to register who may sail for it — the squad the matchday crews are drawn from.

lineup.title: Crew for this matchday
lineup.squadEmpty: The squad is empty — register people for the series first.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.hint: Link a parent's account to a young sailor, and the parent accepts the liability waiver for them online. Only the club does this.
guardians.empty: None of the club's sailors is known here yet — they appear once a squad or an entry holds them, or once their account is a member.

join.requested: You asked to join — the club's admin answers.
join.none: You are in no club yet.
